speech: Welcome to the Harbor History Museum. Regular admission includes the permanent collection and today's guided tour at two thirty. The photography exhibition upstairs needs its own ticket, sold at the information desk. To borrow a free audio guide, leave a photo ID with the attendant. You'll get your ID back after returning the guide. Put bulky luggage in the lockers by the entrance. The museum closes at six. The photography exhibition stops admitting visitors at five.
